selected_evidence.requirement: Serve the inventory application over TCP port 8181 while mandatory access control remains enforcing
selected_evidence.summary: Before and after restart, SELinux is Enforcing, httpd is active and listening on *:8181, the firewall permits 8181/tcp, the local SELinux mapping is http_port_t, and an HTTP request to the managed-node IP returns the inventory application.

Healthy baseline boot ID was 2b19e976-dee2-4700-9045-90d61b6dcffe; the safe reboot was acknowledged; the post-restart boot ID changed to 0acf16e9-49bd-4d79-8b06-76fbeda025db; afterward httpd, the listener, SELinux policy, firewall rule, and application data were healthy with no failed units.
